description: A living glossary for stable project-specific vocabulary shared by humans and HtDP agents.

entries.definition: A complete bracketed query term such as `[git]` that hard-filters Scry results by local hostname/root-name candidates before ordinary token and exact-phrase ranking.
Deterministic local lowercase hostname/root labels used to match website filters, ignoring a common leading `www` label and avoiding public-suffix, network, or lookup-table dependencies.

Scry remains a local Chrome MV3 popup command palette without external network calls, host permissions, content scripts, public-suffix downloads, or external lookup tables unless an issue explicitly changes that boundary.
